title: ExperimentTaskSpace
description:
The factor space a single experiment task declares. Lives at the task root as experiment.json. A task without this file is a single-variant task. Default posture is behavioral: the task declares which factors can vary and which behavioral signals to extract; correctness ground truth (per-level expected) is optional.

Contract shape (explicit split):
- compareBy: which SPACE is under test (the treatment). system = randomized experiment on the stimulus; persona = quasi-experiment contrasting a subject attribute (a classification/blocking factor that cannot be randomly assigned).
- factors[]: the variables that VARY and expand into cells. Each carries its space.
- constants[]: variables PINNED at a single value across every cell (reproducibility + injected as MATRIX_PARAM_*). A constant is a variable fixed to one level; it is NOT the cohort. The cohort (who receives the treatment) lives in persona_strategy.json, never here.
- armAssignment (SUT only): how the sampled cohort is distributed across arms. shared = the same personas run every arm (within-subject; the requested size is per-arm; total trials = N × arms). split = the cohort is partitioned across arms, each persona runs one arm (between-subject; the requested size is the total; ~N/arms per arm). Default shared. Ignored for compareBy=persona, which is always split by nature (a subject cannot be two attribute values at once). Whether analysis pairs by persona follows directly: shared cohorts pair, split cohorts do not.

verifier.description: A built-in generic verifier id under task-spec/verifiers (web_generic, osapp_generic, chatbot_generic, survey_generic) OR the literal "custom" when the task supplies its own verifier in tests/. The only hard rule is that every level must emit the same facet keys so arms stay comparable.

outputArtifact.description: Filename (under the trial output dir) the agent is expected to produce and that signals are read from. Presence of this file is the default task_outcome check.

hypothesis.description: The falsifiable hypothesis this experiment task tests, stated in one or two sentences. Displayed read-only in the workbench.

compareBy.description: Which space is the treatment. system (SUT): arms vary the environment/stimulus while one shared cohort is held. persona (PUT): the environment is pinned in constants[] and arms contrast on a persona attribute. Intrinsic to the task; the workbench does not let the operator flip it.

design.description: ab_n (OFAT: baseline vs each other level), full_factorial (all combinations), or fractional (2-level orthogonal array; falls back to full when no array fits).

armAssignment.description: SUT only: how the sampled cohort is distributed across arms. shared = same personas run every arm (within-subject; requested size is per-arm; total trials = N × arms). split = cohort partitioned across arms, each persona runs one arm (between-subject; requested size is the total; ~N/arms per arm). Prefer shared unless the arm count makes N × arms too expensive. Ignored for compareBy=persona (always split).

selectedFactors.description: Optional subset/ordering of factor ids that participate in the design. Omit to use all declared factors.

submissionSchema.description: Optional correctness mode. Only consulted when a level supplies expected ground truth; behavioral tasks omit it.

signals.description: Declarative Tier-2 behavioral extraction. Each entry lifts a field out of the output artifact into a shared-core facet. Keys MUST be identical across all levels.

metricContract.description: Which emitted facet keys the experiment analysis treats in each role. primary = OEC (drives ship/no-ship), secondary = diagnostic, guardrail = must-not-regress.

factors.description: Variables that vary and expand into cells. Typically all share compareBy's space; for compareBy=persona this holds the single persona-attribute contrast factor.

constants.description: Variables pinned to a single value across every cell (the held, non-treatment side). SUT usually leaves this empty (the environment IS the varying stimulus); PUT pins the environment here. Each constant is injected as MATRIX_PARAM_<ID>. Never the cohort.

id.description: Stable id, snake_case. Injected as MATRIX_PARAM_<ID>.

space.description: Which space this pinned variable belongs to (usually system).

source.description: Artifact filename under the output dir. Defaults to the task-level outputArtifact.

path.description: Dotted path into the source JSON (e.g. basis_primary or decision.subject.id).

reduce.description: count: emit the length of a list/string value instead of the value itself.

key.description: Facet key emitted into the shared-core envelope; must be identical across all levels.

context.description: contextType these facets aggregate under (e.g. decision, decision_process).
